description: Read-only AccessProof production security gates A-J for one organization/application.

runCommand: test "$SELF" = "i-0c11427d4d9c1b438" || { echo "Wrong production instance; refusing" >&2; exit 2; }
test -n "${SSM_organizationId:-}" && test -n "${SSM_applicationId:-}" || { echo "SSM agent does not support ENV_VAR interpolation; refusing" >&2; exit 2; }

state() { c=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.ec2.yml ps -q "$1" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$c" ]; then docker inspect "$c" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; s=json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["State"]; print((s.get("Health") or {}).get("Status") or s.get("Status", "unknown"))'; else echo missing; fi; }
HEAD_REV=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.ec2.yml exec -T api alembic heads 2>/dev/null | awk '/\(head\)/{print $1}')
DB_REV=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.ec2.yml exec -T db psql -U accessproof -d accessproof -tAc "select version_num from alembic_version" | tr -d "[:space:]")

BUNDLE=$(python3 - "$(state api)" "$(state worker)" "$(state db)" "$(state redis)" "$(state web)" "$HEAD_REV" "$DB_REV" "$ROLLBACKS" <<'PYGATES'
import base64
import binascii
import json
import os
import re
import sys
import zlib

raw = os.environ.get("SSM_evidenceGzipB64", "none")
evidence = None
if raw != "none":
    if len(raw) > 3500 or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{100,3500}", raw):
        raise SystemExit("INVALID_SSM_EVIDENCE_PARAMETER")
    try:
        data = base64.b64decode(raw, validate=True)
        inflater = zlib.decompressobj(16 + zlib.MAX_WBITS)
        decoded = inflater.decompress(data, 16385)
        if (len(decoded) > 16384 or not inflater.eof or
                inflater.unconsumed_tail or inflater.unused_data):
            raise ValueError("EVIDENCE_DECOMPRESSION_LIMIT_OR_TRAILING_DATA")
        evidence = json.loads(decoded)
    except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError, binascii.Error, zlib.error) as exc:
        raise SystemExit("INVALID_COMPRESSED_EVIDENCE") from exc
    if (not isinstance(evidence, dict) or
            evidence.get("schema") != "accessproof.source_certification_evidence/v1" or
            evidence.get("organization_id") != os.environ["SSM_organizationId"]):
        raise SystemExit("EVIDENCE_SCOPE_OR_SCHEMA_MISMATCH")

state = sys.argv[1:]
if len(state) != 8:
    raise SystemExit("INVALID_HOST_FACT_COUNT")
facts = {
    "api_healthy": state[0] == "healthy",
    "worker_running": state[1] in ("running", "healthy"),
    "db_healthy": state[2] == "healthy",
    "redis_healthy": state[3] == "healthy",
    "web_healthy": state[4] == "healthy",
    "migration_at_head": bool(state[5]) and state[5] == state[6],
    "rollback_available": int(state[7]) > 0,
}
print(json.dumps({"host_facts": facts, "evidence": evidence}, separators=(",", ":")))
PYGATES
)

printf %s "$BUNDLE" | docker compose -f docker-compose.ec2.yml exec -T api python scripts/production_security_gates.py --organization-id "$SSM_organizationId" --application-id "$SSM_applicationId" --stdin-bundle
